datum: The Lord, He is King of the Apostles. *O come, let us worship Him, Alleluia.
The righteous shall stand * in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted them, Alleluia.
V. O ye Saints and righteous, rejoice in the Lord, Alleluia.
R. God hath chosen you for His own inheritance, Alleluia.

incipit: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, Alleluia;
responsum: That delighteth greatly in His commandments, Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
versus: Glory and riches shall be in his house, and his righteousness endureth for ever.

responsum: Shall be turned to joy, Alleluia, alleluia.
versus: The world shall rejoice, and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow:

incipit: Precious in the sight of the Lord, Alleluia:
responsum: Is the death of His Saints, Alleluia.
versus: The Lord keepeth all their bones, not one of them shall be broken.

datum: Behold, * how they are numbered among the children of God, and their lot is among the Saints, Alleluia.
V. The everlasting light shall shine upon Thy Saints, O Lord, Alleluia.

incipit: The everlasting light shall shine upon Thy Saints, O Lord.
versus: Everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness.

incipit: With great power gave the Apostles:
responsum: Witness of the Resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ, Alleluia.
versus: They were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

incipit: These are the new lambs, who have proclaimed, Alleluia: they came but just now to the well:
responsum: They are all filled with light, Alleluia, alleluia.
versus: They stand before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands.

datum: The everlasting light * shall shine upon Thy Saints, O Lord, even unto everlasting, Alleluia.
V. Everlasting joy upon their heads, Alleluia.
R. They shall obtain joy and gladness, Alleluia.

incipit: I am the true vine, ye are the branches.
responsum: He that abideth in Me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit, Alleluia, alleluia.
versus: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you.

incipit: Her Nazarites are become pure, Alleluia: they reflect the glory of God, Alleluia.
responsum: They are whiter than milk, Alleluia, alleluia.
versus: They are purer than snow, they are whiter than milk, they are more ruddy in body than coral, their polishing is of sapphire.
